title: Site styles
rows: Font for headings: Source Sans Pro (the site's font), Roboto or Roboto Condensed; or the name of a font uploaded to AEM Assets, with heading-font-file below. Empty: the site's font.
Only for a font from AEM Assets (works once your AEM admin has allowed fonts from Assets): path of its regular .woff2 file, e.g. /content/dam/pensionsbc-base/fonts/brand-regular.woff2
Only for a font from AEM Assets: path of its bold .woff2 file (headings are bold).
Font for body text: Source Sans Pro (the site's font) or Roboto; or the name of a font uploaded to AEM Assets, with body-font-file below. Empty: the site's font.
Only for a font from AEM Assets: path of its regular .woff2 file.
Only for a font from AEM Assets: path of its bold .woff2 file.
